source.description: Provenance of a converted public-information post: what was retrieved from where, and who converted it under which rule. A claim by the converter, not an authentication result for the issuing institution.

document.description: Direct source of the text and structured fields.

containers.description: Distribution containers from outermost to innermost. Distinct from the author of the content.

retrievedAt.description: Retrieval time. UTC with an uppercase Z suffix.

converter.description: Identifier of the converter, such as a DID. Correspondence with the signing key is established by the post signature and attestation chain, not by this field alone.

originalDigest.description: Digest over the full byte sequence of the retrieved original document, computed before any re-serialization.

links.description: Related links: stored original, attachments, web references. Presence of a link does not require retrieval or delivery of its target.

sourceRef.description: Reference to a document in its original format.

format.description: Format and version of the original, for example cap-1.2, edxl-de-1.0, jma-xml-1.3.

senderId.description: Sender identifier in the original format.

messageId.description: Message or post identifier in the original format.

sentAt.description: Original issue or send time converted to UTC. The original string representation is kept in the format-specific extension.

revision.description: Revision or serial number carried by the original format. Comparison rules are format-specific.

part.description: Selected part within the document, such as a language or content position. Not a substitute for the original message identifier.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm name, for example sha-256.
